experiment: N1d-new independent within-model E1 diagonal-ridge phase-boundary check
preregistration: W4_独立验证修订执行方案.md §2 (N1d-new)

methods.moment_reuse: one per-coordinate Gram and label projection per rep; all λ values reuse S_r,T_r,S_h,T_h
methods.paired_delta_construction: one random data stream per rep; T_h(delta)=T_h(0)+norm*T_h(unit lowfreq anti-aligned delta)
methods.quadratic_derivative: unweighted six-point least squares in z=lambda/0.08; original-scale linear coefficient c1 is R'(0+) estimate
methods.cubic_sensitivity: same six-point data and unweighted least squares with degree 3; diagnostic only
methods.root: unweighted OLS of mean derivative on seven delta norms, including theory candidate with weight 1; root=-d0/d1
methods.bootstrap: 1000 joint resamples of the same rep indices across all delta norms; identical indices for quadratic and cubic diagnostics; percentile 95% CI
methods.extension_rule: extend 400->800->1600 only when primary CI halfwidth/theory root > 0.20; never triggered by cubic fit or desired verdict
methods.global_benefit: computed on the mean six-λ risk curve; never used as a zero-derivative substitute or verdict input

cubic_sensitivity.role: sensitivity diagnostic only; no effect on verdict or extension
